caption:
I let AI judge 23 of my gym sets. It said STOP to one. And it raised one false alarm.

The false alarm first. On my lunges, the AI judge said STOP. My depth was fine: I'd only turned towards the camera, and the angle fooled it.

So I gave it a second opinion. The system now has three parts:
1. SEE: tracks 17 joints, 30 times a second. Every rep is one dip in a wave. If a joint is hidden, it refuses to judge (4 of my 23 sets).
2. JUDGE: every rep against my own best rep from the same set. Not a textbook.
3. CHECK: a second AI that only watches the video. STOP only when both agree. If they disagree: check the footage.

The one real STOP: my reverse crunch. Short, swung reps. Half reps don't count, and now my AI agrees.

Claude also went through over 200 papers and tools. One warning stood out: the camera angle can fool the agent. My lunges proved it.

Send this to the friend who counts their half reps.

Comment FORM and I'll send you my AI coach prompt + the 3-part diagram.

Next: Salesforce is reportedly letting people go in India, and at the same time hiring a "Lead AI/ML Engineer (LLM Post-Training)" in Bangalore. Many companies are doing the same: cutting jobs and hiring for AI. How do you become the one they hire? Follow along: getting hired, then evals, then post-training.

Small print: Gym Jarvis Ep 3, the Workout Analyser. Gym Jarvis was built over months of weekends. Footage filmed on my phone on 15 and 28 Aug 2026, before the analyser existed, and analysed in Nov. One camera angle. Both AIs are Claude Fable 5.2 with different inputs; they agreed on flag vs no flag in 9 of the 16 sets both could judge. Not training advice. Salesforce layoff reports: People Matters, DNA (19-20 Nov 2026), not confirmed by Salesforce. Job posting: Salesforce careers site, JR368314.
